audit.whatIsWrong: THREE fabricated ability names run through this page. (1) 'Fated Ending' — that is YONE's ultimate, not Hwei's; it appears in whys[4], spikes[1].text, content mid and wants.foe[1]. (2) 'Severed Passage' — not a Hwei ability at all; it appears in whys[3], spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0]. (3) 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — a made-up label used as the matchup's focus ability in eleven fields including focus.text, loading, winCon, enemyWin and breakdown.cooldowns.
audit.why: Hwei's real kit is Signature of the Visionary (P), Subject: Disaster (Q), Subject: Serenity (W), Subject: Torment (E), Spiraling Despair (R). The E palette contains Grim Visage (fear), Gaze of the Abyss (root) and Crushing Maw — that is the crowd control the page was groping for. The packet's own defect line says the page 'never names any of Hwei's abilities', and it is worse than that: it names three abilities he does not have.
audit.corrected: Every instance replaced with the real name — Subject: Torment (E) for the crowd-control palette, Grim Visage for the fear, Spiraling Despair for the ultimate, Molten Fissure / Severing Bolt for the Disaster sub-abilities.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E/R text listing the nine sub-abilities by name

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart reads Hwei x4 then Skill x3; the packet and the content layer read Hwei x6 then Aurelion Sol. Rows 4, 5 and 6 rendered different answers on the two layers.
audit.why: 49.24% over 790 games is even. Hwei owns levels 1-5 — Subject: Disaster is 10s at rank 1 and he always has an answer loaded off one key, while your Q is a 750 channel any crowd control cancels. From level 6 Falling Star gives a stun that beats Grim Visage if you land it first, and Rod of Ages gives the HP and mana to hold the beam through a full palette rotation. A chart giving him six of seven stages does not describe an even lane.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Hwei x4 / Skill / Skill / Aurelion Sol on both layers — the full layer's existing phases[4] and phases[5] whys already describe exactly that, so only win[4], win[5], whys[4], whys[5] and phases[6].side moved. diffRating 7/10 -> 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and content late build Shadowflame/Stormsurge against the full layer's Rod of Ages / Archangel's / Liandry's / Rabadon's, and the level-6 spike gave no numbers.
audit.why: Spiraling Despair is 120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3, and reaches 1300 — just past Falling Star's 1250. That near-tie is the actual level-6 story, not the fabricated 'Fated Ending fear'.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, mid, late, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.carry realigned to Rod of Ages and to 1250-against-1300.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither missingInteractions rule was on the page: that Subject: Disaster and Subject: Torment both cancel an Aurelion Sol channel, and that Subject: Serenity shields him through a burst window.
audit.why: Both Breath of Light and Astral Flight carry the channel flag ('interruptible — any CC cancels it'), and Subject: Torment's Grim Visage and Gaze of the Abyss are the two abilities in the lane that reliably land it. Subject: Serenity is an 18s shield — spending your damage into it wastes the rotation.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, ahead and content early now state both.
sources: enemyKit E hardCC flag, W shield flag cd 18/17.5/17/16.5/16

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Voice of Light' used as an Aurelion Sol ability in spikes[3] and content late; content early says to 'dodge skillshots with lateral movement and E'.
audit.why: Voice of Light is not in the kit. And E is a stationary black hole, not a dodge — Astral Flight (W) is the movement ability.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Breath of Light and Falling Star; early rewritten around dropping the black hole on the wave.
sources: ownerKit ability list and E text

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (defect-catalogue item 3), and its named ability did not exist.
audit.why: The sequencing rule here is concrete: Subject: Torment is 12s at rank 1 and 10s at rank 5, and it is the only palette that can stop your channel, so it is the timer the whole lane runs on.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Subject: Torment 12s->10s with Grim Visage and Gaze of the Abyss named, Subject: Disaster 10s, Spiraling Despair 120s at 1300, plus an explicit 'wait for it before you channel Q'. report[9].t, dosFull[2].d, breakdown.wave and breakdown.feeding add more.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were copy-paste bleed — the crowd-control blurb, tradeGood and tradeBad pasted under titles about stacking stardust, farming the back line, and flying W into his face.
audit.why: dosFull[1] promises 'Farm the back line with E executes' and explained the W flyby; dontsFull[2] promises the W rule and explained the Q channel.
audit.corrected: All three bodies rewritten to match their titles.
sources: ownerKit E cd 12 range 750, Q cd 3

notes: This is the worst page in my slice by a distance. It carried three separate fabricated ability names across nineteen fields — 'Fated Ending' (which is Yone's ultimate), 'Severed Passage' (which is nobody's), and 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' (a made-up label that was the matchup's declared FOCUS ABILITY, appearing in focus.text, loading and the tracker copy). The packet's suspectNames caught none of these; it flagged 'Astral Flight's', which is correct. I edited focus.text because it named an ability that does not exist — if that field feeds a live tracker widget, please confirm the new value 'Hwei Subject: Torment (Fear)' parses the way the widget expects. Chart: I resolved rows 4 and 5 to Skill rather than to the packet's Hwei, because the full layer's existing whys for those rows already described Aurelion Sol gaining and 49.24% does not support a six-of-seven chart. That is the one judgement call here I would want a second opinion on. I also avoided asserting anything about Hwei's sub-ability RANGES — the kit file reports range 0 for Q/W/E because they are palette selectors, so I have no verified number for how far Devastating Fire actually reaches and did not write one.
